idea: Long shot "tilted strip" family: take k−1 rows of a k-grid of side 1/k and replace the final row with a strip of height h, holding k+1 squares rotated by θ and touching alternately the top and bottom. Shrink the other rows to height (1−h)/(k−1). Solve the sum over (h, θ) numerically with exact rotated-square containment, accepting only when it beats the axis-aligned value for that n.
